$description: COMPONENT tokens for Badge. The inset is here rather than in the spacing roles because a badge is not a control: space.control-padding-x and space.control-padding-y size the box a finger presses, and applying them to a caption-sized label produces a chip half again too large. Nothing in the semantic layer means 'the inset of a label that sits inside running text', so the exception is the smaller of the two evils. Everything else Badge needs (radius.pill, font.size.caption, every colour role) is semantic and stays semantic.

padding-x.$description: 8px. Half of space.control-padding-x, which is the ratio that keeps a badge reading as a label rather than as a small button.

padding-y.$description: 2px. Chosen from the line box rather than from the look: caption type at its snug line height is 16.2px, so 2px above and below makes a 20.2px chip that fits inside both the body-small line box (21px) and the body line box (24px). At 4px the chip was 24.2px and measurably reflowed a body-small paragraph it sat inside, which is the whole reason an inline badge needs a stated height.

gap.$description: 4px between an icon and the label. space.control-gap is 8px, which is correct next to 16px body text and visibly loose next to 12px caption text.
